whoWeAre.title: More Than Just Service Providers
paragraphs: At SetupZoneDubai, we are more than just business setup service experts — we are your long-term growth partners. Whether you're launching a startup, expanding to the UAE, or shifting your base to Dubai's thriving market, our mission is to make your journey smooth, compliant, and fast.

With deep knowledge of UAE's Free Zone and Mainland company formation jurisdictions, we help entrepreneurs, freelancers, and corporations launch and scale seamlessly. From securing your trade license to setting up corporate bank accounts, we offer complete business setup solutions.
Our team ensures your UAE business is fully compliant, investor-ready, and positioned for long-term success.

whatMakesUsDifferent.title: Expertise You Can Trust
paragraphs: At SetupZoneDubai, we don't only provide business setup services, we provide custom business launch solutions that are quick, cost effective, and tailored according to your goals.

We have helped businesses ranging from choosing the appropriate Free Zone or Mainland jurisdiction through to securing trade licenses, investor visas, and corporate bank accounts. You have access to expert advice through every step.

The clients love our transparent pricing, multilingual support, and 100% guarantee for compliance, which gives entrepreneurs, startups and foreign investors in the UAE the confidence required to start and grow a Dubai business without effort.

items.q: How much does it cost to start a business in Dubai?
items.a: Business setup in Dubai starts from AED 9,500 for a basic free zone license. Mainland setup starts from AED 14,500.

items.q: Can a foreigner 100% own a company in Dubai?
items.a: Yes, foreigners can 100% own companies in most free zones and many mainland activities.

items.q: What is the cheapest free zone in Dubai?
items.a: RAK ICC, Ajman FTZ, and SRTIP offer the most affordable packages starting from AED 5,900.

items.q: How long does company registration take in Dubai?
items.a: Free zone registration takes 3-7 business days. Mainland takes 2-4 weeks.

items.q: Do I need a local partner in Dubai?
items.a: Not in free zones. In mainland, many activities now allow 100% foreign ownership.
